description: To the payload corresponding JSON schema file is `CollectionInformation.json`

nodata.description: If no item is present in the collection, tis (optional) element may express a reason for that.

collection.description: Information on the skipped pages, number of returned items and the total number of collection items at the server.

number.description: The number of pages skipped in the response that may be limited with a request query parameter (limited to a maximum of signed 32 bit).

size.description: The actual number of items returned in the response that may be limited with a request query parameter.

total.description: The total numbers of existing items in the whole collection at the server.
